reuse.why: Extends isNonWorkingDay, the single holiday check that isSkippedWeekendOccurrence and the rest of shared/schedules.ts already route through.

duplication.why: Adds one small isHoliday helper; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts beside the other weekend-rule predicates.

scope.why: Helper, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Clear named helper; distinguishing formats by holiday.length === 5 is a little implicit but readable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay -> isHoliday.
